_note: Exactly what the first playable slice (Checkpoint 1) contains. If it is not listed as 'in', it is absent or hidden. tools/validate.py checks every id here against the other data files.
purpose: decide whether movement, herding and ring closure are enjoyable enough to build the rest around
players: built for 1-4 (shared clock, atomic claims) but ACCEPTED solo only

loop: server claim validation with lag compensation
round: shared 110 s clock and 10 s intermission (existing Cycle)
results sheet (score, medal from medalsProvisional, best loop size, next round countdown)
onboarding: hint: Run a circle around the Sparks
hint: Dash to snap a ring shut (after the first Bunvolt escape)
debug: F9 tuning panel: ribbon lifetime, snap radius, dash distance, walk speed, camera pitch/distance, creature scale (Studio only, session only)
claimDeviation telemetry in the F8 overlay

stubbed.PINCH: walls block creatures and are built, but ribbon-to-wall closure is stage 2 (WP-13). No pinch hint in the slice
stubbed.golden_runaway: not spawned; the finale is the x1.5 loop multiplier only
stubbed.results: no Best Loop card drawing, no next-goal line, no CLAIM button
stubbed.audio: see cues below: existing WAVs via built-in fallbacks unless the owner uploads; music = existing music_meadow + finale layer

off.heat_and_perks: forced to Heat 0, no perks; Play Setup tab hidden
off.upgrades: Upgrades tab hidden; boots/magnet/basket levels ignored (fixed tuning values) so the feel under test is the same for everyone
off.arena_travel: Canyon and Aurora are locked in the menu (old layouts still exist behind worldLegacy but are not reachable)
off.profile_changes: profile stays v3; glow and XP still accrue through the existing bank/round paths; quests keyed to old counters keep counting TIGHT as precision and SNAP as dashCatches

cues._note: Audio the slice plays. 'asset' names a WAV: existing = already in assets/audio; new = to be generated in WP-07 with the recipe in 11 section 5. Every id is silent or on a built-in placeholder until the owner uploads and runs tools/set_audio_ids.py, so audio is NOT judged at Checkpoint 1.

sfx.asset: existing: catch.wav, PlaybackSpeed = 2^(step/12) on the pentatonic ladder
existing: start_whistle.wav @ speed 0.75 (the real horn is WP-17)

music.notInSlice: stems B and C, intermission low-pass, x4 tambourine

cues.voices: none in the slice except the Bunvolt hop wind-up, which reuses pop.wav @ speed 0.5 (it is gameplay information)
